visual_form.spatial_logic: Door, key, quay, or arrival point reads simultaneously as departure and return; foreground and background can echo one another.
visual_form.figure_ground: The threshold is the figure; direction remains deliberately ambiguous.

visual_form.spatial_logic: Two figures or states overlap in a handoff: one fades, exits, or loses opacity as the other enters or solidifies.
visual_form.density: Moderate with a visible transfer zone.
visual_form.figure_ground: The transition between old and new is more important than either isolated figure.

visual_form.spatial_logic: Three figures, times, rooms, or conceptual poles make a stable relational triangle rather than a line.
visual_form.figure_ground: The empty center formed by the three may carry the synthesis.

visual_form.spatial_logic: Grid, map, room, bridge system, or four-direction field creates a bounded stage for wandering.
visual_form.figure_ground: Container and routes within it are equally legible.

visual_form.spatial_logic: One figure/star/shape sits at or beyond the edge of a four-square social field and refuses clean fit.
visual_form.density: Sparse around the outsider, denser inside the norm.
visual_form.figure_ground: Misfit between figure and frame is the compositional fact.

visual_form.spatial_logic: Two separated figures, signs, or selves recognize relation across a charged distance while a third material process—forge, word, gesture—makes the category real.
visual_form.density: Moderate, centered on the relational bridge.
visual_form.figure_ground: Identity appears in the between-space rather than as a preexisting badge.

visual_form.spatial_logic: One side is visibly outnumbered or outweighed; three-versus-four, one-versus-many, or an unbalanced scale refuses cosmetic centering.
visual_form.rhythm: Unequal measures held in one frame.
visual_form.figure_ground: Negative space and mass expose the inequality rather than correcting it.

visual_form.spatial_logic: Past layers remain visible through present ones—maps, waves, handwriting, ruins, repeated poses—so history presses and carries at once.
visual_form.rhythm: Recurring strata rather than linear march.
visual_form.figure_ground: No single temporal layer completely erases another.

visual_form.spatial_logic: Door, hand, chair, bed, path, star, or speech space is offered but not yet occupied; the composition reserves room for an answer.
visual_form.figure_ground: Empty receptive space is active, not unfinished.

visual_form.spatial_logic: Spiral, ring, river-loop, circular typography, or repeated threshold makes the final unit touch the first and point beyond itself.
visual_form.figure_ground: The exit line becomes the entry line.

visual_form.composition_law: Young resistant consciousness in an adult world.
visual_form.spatial_logic: A younger/smaller figure with books, tower, sea, or intellectual apparatus is visually acute but not yet integrated into surrounding life.
visual_form.density: Moderate with isolation around the child/young artist.
visual_form.figure_ground: Potential is sharp; participation is incomplete.

visual_form.spatial_logic: A mature figure bends toward, accompanies, makes, carries, cooks, or witnesses; composition supports another person instead of placing the father above them.
visual_form.figure_ground: The caring gesture organizes the field more than paternal authority.

visual_form.spatial_logic: A substantial body, bed, room, food, or domestic ground anchors the image horizontally and materially; consciousness arises from inhabitation rather than ascent.
visual_form.figure_ground: Body and room form one foundation rather than figure floating over setting.

visual_form.composition_law: Affirmation expands through the whole field.
visual_form.spatial_logic: One yes/gesture/breath/flowering rhythm opens the composition outward until memory, body, landscape, and text participate in the same consent.
visual_form.figure_ground: Figure and ground stop arguing; the whole field answers.
